about: Trigger test set. An agent client picks a skill from its name and description alone. Each prompt under `must` must select that skill. Each prompt under `nearMiss` must select the skill in `expect`, or no Taskade skill when `expect` is `none`. scripts/check-triggers.mjs checks the shape of this file. TRIGGERS.md records how each prompt was judged.
